summary.name: Fine-Line Chinese Painted Scroll
summary.visualIdentity: Fine bounded contours outline jade mountains, cloud curls, architecture, flowers and figures over translucent pale washes on light paper or silk. The style is extracted and source-inspired. It is not a claim that all Chinese painting uses this palette.
summary.suitableUses: Inferred suitability: calm landscape or heritage narratives that benefit from slow panoramic reveals. Explicit scope: scroll-unrolling panorama with preserved open space. Target audience, topic and copy are unspecified.
summary.limitations: No ink splashes or thick outlines are allowed. Parallax must stay shallow. Figures need rigged layers or drawn gesture frames. Calligraphy or seals appear only if verified. Source sampling covered one frame per second from 1 to 8 seconds only.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent; #F0EEDD silk is only an illustrative swatch. Suggested roles are foreground #3B544D, jade #86B6A2, mountain #B5CEC0, warm paper #D8C6A5 and rose #D2A6A3. These hex values are authored, not measured. Approved task colors take precedence, gradients are disabled, and captions need readable contrast checked against the textured field.
summary.motionAndInteraction: From 0 to 1.3 seconds, DrawSVG draws the contours, and each wash reveals only after its contour group completes. From 1.3 to 3.0 seconds, a bird follows an authored path, petals drift, a sleeve sways about a pivot, and the cloud band shifts 1–2%, then holds. Full video uses a scroll-unrolling pan with an optional procedural edge curl. No interactivity is specified.
summary.audio: Audio is unspecified because the brief supplies none. Music, voice, ambience or silence are optional suggestions, and no historical soundtrack should be assumed. Silent previews are acceptable. Any sound should leave room for narration or captions.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are required. Optional inputs include layered illustration, high-resolution PNG or SVG parallax layers, rigged figure layers or drawn gesture frames, and verified calligraphy or seal assets when supplied. No motion references are included.
summary.combinations: Style-038 is the only example supporting style, and its role is unspecified. Keep Fine-Line Chinese Painted Scroll dominant and preserve approved colors. Avoid generic effects that replace its mark-making, and avoid invented historical text. Combinations are optional.
summary.productionApproach: SVG draws the visuals, and Canvas 2D adds only the silk texture. GSAP with DrawSVGPlugin owns motion through one paused timeline. chroma.js optionally validates colors. HyperFrames is the default for composition and export, and Remotion requires a verified limitation. Verify seeks, decoded frames and audio sync.
